FX-OFFSET-001.says: The settings as they start, shift 0, 0: the drawing, untouched.

FX-OFFSET-002.says: Shift 3, 0: every pixel moves exactly three pixels right, and the three columns that leave the right edge come back in at the left, so the red dot is at (2, 0) and the soft edge down column 1.

FX-OFFSET-003.says: Shift 0, 2: every pixel moves exactly two pixels down, and the skin block's two lowest rows come back in at the top, in rows 0 and 1; the red dot is at (15, 2).

FX-OFFSET-004.says: Shift -3, -2, left and up: every pixel moves exactly; the white block's left three columns come back in at the right, in columns 13 to 15, and its top row at the bottom, in row 9; the red dot is at (12, 8).

FX-OFFSET-005.says: Shift 8, 5, half the drawing each way: the four quarters change places corner to corner, so the red dot, from the top right corner, is at (7, 5) in the middle; the white block, from the left edge, is in columns 8 to 12 and rows 6 to 9; and the skin block, from the bottom right, is in columns 1 to 5 and rows 0 to 4.

FX-OFFSET-006.says: Shift 16, 10, one whole width and height: every pixel comes back to its own place, and the drawing is untouched.

FX-OFFSET-007.says: Shift 35, -23, more than twice round each way: exactly the same as shift 3, -3, as 35 is two widths and 3, and -23 is three heights up and 7 down again.

FX-OFFSET-008.says: Shift 100000, -100000, the most each way: 100000 is a whole number of widths (6250) and of heights (10000), so the drawing is untouched.

FX-OFFSET-009.says: Shift -99999, 99999: thousands of times round, and exactly the same as shift 1, -1.

FX-OFFSET-010.says: Shift 0.5, 0, half a pixel right: every pixel is the even mix of itself and the one to its left, column 0 mixing with column 15 round the wrap, so the red dot shows half-covering at (0, 0) and (15, 0), and the soft edge spreads to column 15 at about a quarter covering.

FX-OFFSET-011.says: Shift -2.25, 1.75, a part of a pixel both ways: every pixel is a mix of four, with weights 9/16, 3/16, 3/16 and 1/16, wrapped; nothing is lost and nothing gained, each channel's total over the frame is the drawing's.

FX-OFFSET-012.says: Shift -31.5, 20.25, part-pixel shifts nearly twice round: exactly the same as shift 0.5, 0.25.

FX-OFFSET-013.says: Shift keyed from 0, 0 at frame 0 to 8, 4 at frame 4, linear: frame 0 untouched, frame 2 is shift 4, 2, and frame 4 is shift 8, 4, each moved exactly.

FX-OFFSET-014.says: Shift keyed from 0, 0 at frame 0 to 3, 1 at frame 4, linear: frame 2 falls between whole pixels, at 1.5, 0.5, and is the plain case of that shift, softened by the mix: the red dot is spread over four pixels, a quarter covering at (1, 0).

FX-OFFSET-015.says: Shift keyed from 0, 0 at frame 0 to 100000, 0 at frame 4, eased past its end (132500 at frame 2): frame 2 is held at 100000, a whole number of widths, so it is the drawing untouched, as frame 4 is; unheld it would have slid four pixels.

FX-OFFSET-016.says: Shift 3, 0, the layer moved three pixels right: FX-OFFSET-002 moved; the wrap stays inside the layer's own pixels, so the three columns left of it stay empty.

FX-OFFSET-017.says: A drop shadow two pixels right, then shift 16, 0: the shadow grew the layer two pixels on every side, to 20 by 14, and the wrap goes round that, so 16 is not a whole width: it is shift -4 on the grown layer, and the shadow and the drawing slide four pixels left.

FX-OFFSET-018.says: A drop shadow two pixels right, then shift 20, 14, the grown layer's whole width and height: the drawing with its shadow, as the drop shadow alone draws it.

FX-OFFSET-019.says: Shift 100001, 0: x above 100000. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.

FX-OFFSET-020.says: Shift 0, -100001: y below -100000. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.

FX-OFFSET-021.says: Shift 100000.5, 0: x past 100000 by half a pixel. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.

FX-OFFSET-022.says: Shift keyed to 150000, 0 at frame 4. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.

FX-OFFSET-023.says: Shift keyed to 0, -100001 at frame 4. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.
